title: Hively and Woodside paper on extended electrodynamics

tellings.quote: there's a guy named Lee Hiveley uh in Colorado Springs and he has a a colleague named Woodside who I believe is in Australia

plain: Michels points to a paper on extended electrodynamics, a proposed broadening of the standard theory of electricity and magnetism, written by a man named Lee Hively in Colorado Springs and a colleague named Woodside, who Michels believes lives in Australia. Michels brings it up himself, on an episode where Eric Weinstein questions a Pentagon scientist. He does not say what the paper finds, only that it is work he thinks bears on the physics behind unexplained craft.
